abstract_sentences.text: Optimal-Transport Distributionally Robust Optimization (OT-DRO) robustifies data-driven decision-making under uncertainty by capturing the sampling-induced statistical error via optimal transport ambiguity sets.

abstract_sentences.text: The standard OT-DRO pipeline consists of a two-step procedure, where the ambiguity set is first designed and subsequently embedded into the downstream OT-DRO problem.

abstract_sentences.text: We introduce an end-to-end pipeline to automatically learn decision-focused ambiguity sets for OT-DRO problems, where the loss function informs the shape of the optimal transport ambiguity set, leading to less conservative yet distributionally robust decisions.

evidence.anchor: We introduce an end-to-end pipeline to automatically learn decision-focused ambiguity sets for OT-DR

claim_closure.claim: Loss-aware geometry yields less conservative decisions at maintained robustness.
claim_closure.method_response: Equations (5)–(17), Figure 1, and Algorithm 1 learn θ under a bootstrap surrogate.
claim_closure.evidence_response: Figures 2–5 and 8–13 show within-method synthetic improvements.
claim_closure.conclusion_response: Outlook repeats less-conservative yet reliable decisions.

claim_closure.claim: The hypergradient algorithm converges despite nonsmooth lower-level solution maps.
claim_closure.method_response: Assumption 5.1 supplies the needed path-differentiability conditions.
claim_closure.evidence_response: Theorem 5.1 and its immediate proof establish conditional critical-point convergence.

claim_closure.method_response: Bootstrap counts nominal-to-resample distances and penalizes violation.
claim_closure.evidence_response: Figure 3 and Figure 15 provide empirical evidence.
claim_closure.conclusion_response: The limitation explicitly states that no theoretical lower bound is known.

claim_closure.claim: The method covers portfolio optimization and linear regression.
claim_closure.method_response: Appendix A provides task-specific conic reformulations.
claim_closure.evidence_response: Section 6 and Appendix F cover both task families and variants.
claim_closure.conclusion_response: Outlook names finance and machine learning.

claim_closure.claim: The design can be a general-purpose differentiable layer for any conic ambiguity set.
claim_closure.method_response: The paper describes a conic-program derivative route.
claim_closure.evidence_response: No non-OT ambiguity-set implementation or experiment is presented.
claim_closure.conclusion_response: No direct empirical closure in the conclusion.

lexical_rhetorical_analysis.corpus_boundary: Main text including abstract, excluding References, display formulas, table numerals, and page templates.

strong_vs_qualified_claim_units.coding_boundary: 27 manually identified authorial claim units in abstract, contribution list, theorem/results, and conclusion.

final_judgment.single_storyline: Learn transport-cost geometry from the downstream loss through bilevel hypergradients, while a bootstrap penalty constrains over-optimistic ambiguity-set shrinkage.
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: Problem, coverage surrogate, penalty, Algorithm 1, conditional convergence theorem, and two core task families stay in the main body.
final_judgment.appendix_moves: Conic derivations, conservative-Jacobian details, stabilized Algorithm 2, hyperparameters, synthetic generators, extra settings, complexity, and sensitivity analysis move to the appendix.
final_judgment.best_pattern: Figure 1 turns the abstract geometry claim into a simple visual mechanism; each task then follows a single case, aggregate evidence, and a coverage/robustness check.
final_judgment.largest_gap: Coverage is central to the reliability claim but has no theoretical lower bound; main comparisons are within-method and main error bars are not defined.
final_judgment.transfer_rule: When learning the geometry of a robust-optimization object, keep the visual mechanism, executable update, coverage constraint, and task-level evidence together in the main text.
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: Do not phrase empirical coverage as a theorem when the coverage guarantee has not been established; restrict claims to tested tasks and stated assumptions.
final_judgment.appendix_self_sufficiency: The main text is conceptually readable, but strict reproduction and generality assessment require the appendix.
final_judgment.adverse_pattern_boundary: Observed presentation choices are reported without attributing intent.
